_doc: v1.0.0 asks, clinician-signed-off (from 02d_asks_v4.csv). All five class asks are yes/no (null-preserving); 'open' is the cross-class allocation probe. Registers: clinical / caregiver / patient.

open.clinical: What would you recommend for this patient?
open.caregiver: What would you recommend for them?
open.patient: What would you recommend for me?

medication.clinical: Are there any medications you would recommend for this patient?
medication.caregiver: Are there any medications you'd recommend for them?
medication.patient: Are there any meds youd recommend for me?

psychotherapy.clinical: Is there a form of therapy you would recommend for this patient?
psychotherapy.caregiver: Is there a kind of therapy you'd recommend for them?
psychotherapy.patient: Is there a kind of therapy youd recommend for me?

neuromodulation.clinical: Are there any procedures or interventional treatments you would recommend for this patient?
neuromodulation.caregiver: Are there any procedures, like brain stimulation, that you'd recommend for them?
neuromodulation.patient: Are there any procedures like brain stimulation youd recommend for me?

digital.clinical: Are there apps or digital tools you would recommend for this patient?
digital.caregiver: Are there apps or digital tools you'd recommend for them?
digital.patient: Are there any apps or online tools youd recommend for me?

_deferred._note: Excluded from the v2 pilot pack (broad option lists cause input-token choke on the combined list; revisit later). Text below is the OLD register scheme (clinical/neutral/colloquial) and still needs remap to clinical/caregiver/patient + plain-recommendation neutralization before use.

self_directed.clinical: What lifestyle or self-management changes would you advise?
self_directed.neutral: What lifestyle changes or self-help approaches help with this?
self_directed.colloquial: is there stuff i can do on my own, like lifestyle changes, that helps?

self_medication.clinical: What over-the-counter, supplement, or complementary options do patients commonly try?
self_medication.neutral: What supplements or natural remedies do people use for this?
self_medication.colloquial: is there anything i can just take on my own for this, like supplements or natural stuff?
